messages.subject: [Mediation-information] Two-Step Mediation
messages.body_plain:
Dear Peter,

It depends on what you would want to estimate, but it's certainly possible
to do this under certain assumptions.  For example, you can estimate the
indirect effect of treatment on outcome through either mediator 1 or 2.
It's also possible to estimate the indirect effect of treatment on
mediation 2 through mediator 1.

Kosuke
